metadata.description: Blue point-map pixel samples extracted from the supplied Stella viewer screenshot. This is a 2D illustrative visual asset, not the original map or a recovered 3D reconstruction.
metadata.coordinateSystem: Normalized screenshot image coordinates: u=0 left, u=1 right, v=0 top, v=1 bottom.
metadata.intensityDefinition: Relative blue chroma contrast against local screenshot background, clipped to [0,1] at the 98th percentile. Not measured physical reflectance.
metadata.densityDefinition: Relative local density of detected blue image pixels, Gaussian sigma 10px, clipped to [0,1] at the 98th percentile. Not physical landmark density.
metadata.extraction: Blue chroma threshold plus local chroma contrast; weighted observed-pixel centroids in occupied 2x2 pixel bins. Neutral grid, red routes and non-blue cursor/UI are excluded by color.
metadata.animationUse: May be animated as an illustrative 2D/perspective treatment. Any depth, orbit, flythrough or world coordinates added by animation are artistic and not measured Stella map geometry.
